declared: 2026-10-22 before any new real-data execution; historical corpus inspection disclosed
unit: whole study, all experiments and signatures kept together
scope_reporting: off is the historical-lead/talk scope; phenotype is a declared sensitivity; report each separately without choosing a favorable scope
trait_rule: training Noel sign screen: tested and down > up; p ascending, scored studies descending, trait ID ascending; no forced cellulose
triple_rule: training scan API: exact Feces, exact condition labels, study-disjoint triples only; select one minimum observed mean pairwise Jaccard distance per chosen trait; ties broken by lexicographically sorted condition tuple
heldout_null: scanner U6 whole-study-signature null; only held-out studies enter its pool; no replacement of untestable selections
family: per split, every training-selected trait/triple crossed with both statistics; untestable members retained at internal p=1 and exported null
correction: BY primary, BH comparison, using the additive unified engine
heldout_exclusions: undefined distance in any null draw (distance only)
across_splits: descriptive selection/testability/rejection counts only; no pooled p-value, best-split claim or independent-replication claim
interpretation: internal exploratory assessment conditional on U6 exchangeability; not external validation or retrospective preregistration
